a_text: Month-to-month moves smaller than about 2–3 points at the national level are generally within sampling noise.

proposed_wording: As a rule of thumb, a change of less than about 3 points between two months at the national level is within sampling error.

a_text: For example, June (38.3%) to July (37.6%) is not a meaningful change.

proposed_wording: For example, the dip from June (38.3%) to July (37.6%) is not statistically distinguishable from no change.

proposed_wording: Yes. Purchase intent in the South has grown faster than in the Northeast over the last 12 months, although comparisons of single months are noisy.
